reasoning_structure: An odd-sized roster of scalar records is sorted; the middle order statistic, rather than a sum or mean, determines the supported option.
initial_key_fact: The currently active roster fixes both the ordering and the unique middle record.
answer_generation_mechanism: Sort all active values and select the value at the frozen median rank.
v_changed_node: One record that straddles the middle rank is directly corrected while roster size and all other records remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: Re-sorting the corrected roster moves a different value into the middle rank and uniquely selects the target.
migration_structure: Each variant uses a distinct preassigned A/B/C migration; only the V record correction changes the median-selected option.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The nearest arithmetic family aggregates weighted values and the nearest logic family resolves an external tie. This family uses an order statistic with no weighting or tie-break, and V changes rank occupancy rather than a weight or priority rule.

reasoning_structure: A serial process has several stage capacities; feasible throughput is the minimum effective capacity after stage-specific derating.
initial_key_fact: One named stage has the unique smallest effective capacity under its recorded availability factor.
answer_generation_mechanism: Compute each effective stage capacity and choose the minimum as system throughput.
v_changed_node: The availability factor of a non-bottleneck stage is directly corrected so that its effective capacity falls below the old bottleneck.
v_update_mechanism: Recomputing the stagewise minimum makes the corrected stage the unique bottleneck and selects the target throughput.
migration_structure: V changes the argmin stage and therefore the supported throughput option; N/AO/S leave all capacities active.
nonisomorphism_rationale: Earlier families allocate quantities across tiers or inventory layers. Here the operator is a minimum over parallel capacity calculations; no tier crossing, reservation, or additive allocation occurs.

reasoning_structure: A required quantity must be packed into indivisible equal-capacity containers; container count is a ceiling division and total cost includes a per-container charge.
initial_key_fact: The active requirement and container capacity place the quotient in a specific open interval between consecutive integers.
answer_generation_mechanism: Compute ceil(required/capacity), then apply the frozen per-container cost.
v_changed_node: A packing certificate directly corrects usable capacity per container while the requirement and price remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected divisor crosses a ceiling boundary, changing the integer container count and uniquely selecting the target total.
migration_structure: V changes a discrete ceiling count; the social and exposure arms do not alter the quotient inputs.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The old boundary family concerns inclusion of endpoint transactions and the rounding family concerns when decimals are rounded. This family uses exact indivisibility and a mathematical ceiling operator, with no ambiguous endpoint or rounding convention.

reasoning_structure: Items pass through independent serial stages; final good output is the starting count multiplied by every stage yield factor.
initial_key_fact: All recorded stage yields jointly determine a unique multiplicative survival fraction.
answer_generation_mechanism: Multiply the starting count by the frozen sequence of stage yields and select the exact final output.
v_changed_node: A quality report directly corrects one stage yield while the start count and other yields remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: Replacing one factor changes the product and uniquely selects the target output.
migration_structure: V replaces one multiplicative factor; N/AO/S preserve the original product.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The contingency family reasons about dependence of probabilistic events and the pool family computes a weighted mean. This family is a deterministic serial-yield product with neither probabilistic joint inference nor normalized averaging.

reasoning_structure: A closed ledger maps account classes to debit-normal or credit-normal signs; the requested balance is a signed sum under that mapping.
initial_key_fact: Each listed entry has a frozen formal account class, including one contra account whose sign differs from its neighboring ordinary account.
answer_generation_mechanism: Map every entry through the class-to-sign table and sum the signed amounts.
v_changed_node: An account master record directly corrects the formal class of one entry from ordinary to contra, or vice versa.
v_update_mechanism: The class correction reverses exactly one signed contribution and yields the target net balance.
migration_structure: Only V changes one ledger sign through an explicit class field; target mention and pressure leave the classification unchanged.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The old class family changes denominator membership and the currency family changes monetary basis. This family retains every entry and currency but changes a class-defined algebraic sign in a double-entry balance.

reasoning_structure: A posted amount is explicitly tax-inclusive; the untaxed base is recovered by dividing by one plus the stated rate, not by subtracting a percentage of the gross.
initial_key_fact: The price-status field identifies the recorded amount as gross and fixes the applicable rate.
answer_generation_mechanism: Invert gross = base*(1+rate) to compute the unique base amount.
v_changed_node: A jurisdiction record directly replaces the applicable rate while the gross amount and inclusive status remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: Re-inverting the same gross under the corrected rate produces the target base.
migration_structure: V changes the denominator in an inverse-percent equation; all non-evidence arms retain the original rate.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The reciprocal-unit family reverses a measurement orientation and the order family composes adjustments. Here a stated gross/base equation is algebraically inverted once; no unit orientation or ordering choice is involved.

reasoning_structure: A trip contains equal-distance legs at different speeds; total average speed is total distance divided by total travel time, yielding a harmonic rather than arithmetic mean.
initial_key_fact: The route record states that the legs have equal distance and supplies each leg speed.
answer_generation_mechanism: Assign a common leg distance, sum distance/speed times, and divide total distance by total time.
v_changed_node: A route audit directly corrects the distance ratio between the legs while speeds remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected distance weights change total time and therefore the uniquely supported average speed.
migration_structure: V changes physical distance weights in a time denominator; N/AO/S retain the original route geometry.
nonisomorphism_rationale: Although both nearest families involve weights or reciprocals, this answer is derived from the conserved distance/time definition. V changes route-leg distances, not sample counts or the orientation of a quoted unit.

reasoning_structure: Failed units may be reworked for a fixed number of passes; expected accepted output is accumulated through a finite recurrence rather than a one-pass percentage.
initial_key_fact: The process record fixes the first-pass yield, rework yield, and exact maximum number of rework passes.
answer_generation_mechanism: Iterate remaining and accepted quantities for the frozen number of passes and sum accepted output.
v_changed_node: A workflow record directly corrects the permitted rework-pass count while both yield rates remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: Adding or removing one recurrence step changes accumulated accepted output to the target.
migration_structure: V changes recurrence depth; the fixed rates and all non-evidence arms preserve the initial finite series.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The old families concern probabilistic dependence or cyclic state transitions. This family uses a deterministic quantity recurrence with absorbing accepted output and a corrected finite horizon.

reasoning_structure: A code is matched against several nested prefixes; the frozen rule assigns the label of the longest matching prefix.
initial_key_fact: The active routing table contains a unique most-specific prefix for the queried code.
answer_generation_mechanism: Enumerate matching prefixes and choose the label attached to the longest one.
v_changed_node: A routing-table correction directly replaces or removes the most-specific prefix entry while broader entries remain.
v_update_mechanism: The next-longest active match becomes decisive and selects the target label.
migration_structure: V changes one table key in a specificity lookup; target exposure and pressure do not alter the prefix table.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The version family uses an explicit selector and the priority family compares a stated relation. Here priority is generated mechanically by prefix length over simultaneously matching keys, and V changes the key set rather than a selector or priority edge.

reasoning_structure: Version labels are compared componentwise under an explicitly stated semantic-version rule in which prerelease identifiers precede the corresponding release.
initial_key_fact: The two candidate versions differ at one frozen precedence component, including release/prerelease status.
answer_generation_mechanism: Parse the labels into ordered components and apply the supplied precedence rule at the first differing component.
v_changed_node: A release manifest directly corrects one version's prerelease identifier or release status.
v_update_mechanism: Re-parsing the corrected label reverses the first decisive precedence comparison and selects the target.
migration_structure: V changes a token inside one structured version label; all other arms retain the original lexical objects.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The old version family decides which rule version is active and the tie-break family applies an external lexicographic priority. This family compares version objects themselves under a supplied component grammar, with no rule selector or tied score.

reasoning_structure: A measurement is represented by a closed uncertainty interval; labels depend on full containment in an acceptance band, full exclusion, or partial overlap.
initial_key_fact: The reported center and uncertainty width place the entire interval in exactly one of the three defined relations to the band.
answer_generation_mechanism: Construct both interval endpoints and classify the interval-band relation using the frozen containment rule.
v_changed_node: A calibration certificate directly corrects the uncertainty width while the center and acceptance band remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected endpoints change containment to overlap or exclusion and uniquely select the target label.
migration_structure: V changes interval width rather than a point estimate; N/AO/S preserve both endpoints.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The boundary family classifies endpoint events and the interpolation family estimates a point on a scale. This family classifies a whole uncertainty set by containment, with V changing interval width rather than endpoint inclusion or interpolation law.

reasoning_structure: A record is split at unescaped delimiters; an escape marker makes the following delimiter literal, so field position depends on a deterministic scan.
initial_key_fact: The active record and escape rule determine a unique sequence of parsed fields and therefore a unique field label.
answer_generation_mechanism: Scan left to right, consume escape pairs, split only on unescaped delimiters, and read the specified field index.
v_changed_node: A raw-record correction directly inserts or removes one escape marker before a delimiter.
v_update_mechanism: Re-parsing changes the field boundaries and makes the target string occupy the queried field.
migration_structure: V changes one syntactic escape flag; the parsing algorithm and target-neutral arms remain fixed.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The old grouping family parses unit-expression parentheses and the scope family binds quantified variables. This family performs a sequential escaped-delimiter scan over a flat record; no algebraic unit grouping or logical variable binding is used.

reasoning_structure: A supplied encoding table uses one logarithmic multiplier for power-like ratios and another for amplitude-like ratios; a quantity-type field selects the formula.
initial_key_fact: The record explicitly classifies the measured ratio as one quantity type and supplies a positive ratio.
answer_generation_mechanism: Select the formula from the type field, apply the stated logarithmic rule, and map the encoded value to an option.
v_changed_node: A metadata correction directly changes the quantity type while the numerical ratio remains fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The selector changes the logarithmic multiplier and yields the target encoded value.
migration_structure: V changes the formula selector, not the observed ratio; N/AO/S retain the original type metadata.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The old power family checks physical dimensions and the coefficient family binds a coefficient to a channel. This family applies one of two explicitly supplied logarithmic encodings based on a categorical quantity type.

reasoning_structure: A service label is keyed by the ordered pair (transport protocol, port); identical port numbers under different protocols map independently.
initial_key_fact: The packet record fixes both components of the composite key and the table has exactly one matching pair.
answer_generation_mechanism: Form the ordered protocol-port key and retrieve its exact table label.
v_changed_node: A packet-header correction directly changes the protocol component while retaining the numeric port.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected ordered pair addresses a different table row and uniquely selects the target service label.
migration_structure: V changes one coordinate of a composite key; social and exposure arms leave both key fields active.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The axis family permutes coordinate meanings and the sensor family transfers evidence across scopes. Here field meanings never move and no evidence is transferred; an exact ordered tuple selects one lookup row.

reasoning_structure: Requested permission bits are filtered by a mask; the effective label is computed by retaining requested bits not blocked by the mask.
initial_key_fact: The request bits and active mask jointly determine a unique effective bit pattern.
answer_generation_mechanism: Apply the supplied bit rule requested AND NOT mask, then translate the result through the frozen label table.
v_changed_node: A policy record directly corrects one active mask bit while requested permissions remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: Recomputing the Boolean mask changes one effective bit and selects the target label.
migration_structure: V changes a mask operand; the mapping table and non-evidence arms remain unchanged.
nonisomorphism_rationale: Parity reduces a set of bits to one parity value and allocation eligibility changes set membership. This family performs componentwise masking and then an exact bit-pattern lookup; no parity aggregation or allocation denominator appears.

reasoning_structure: Given the weekday of a month's first day, a deterministic calendar rule locates the nth occurrence of a named weekday and assigns its date label.
initial_key_fact: The active calendar anchor and requested occurrence number uniquely determine the date.
answer_generation_mechanism: Compute the offset to the named weekday, add whole weeks, and map the resulting date to an option.
v_changed_node: A calendar bulletin directly corrects the weekday of the month's first day while month length and occurrence request stay fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected anchor shifts every occurrence and makes the target date uniquely supported.
migration_structure: V changes the calendar anchor; N/AO/S retain the same weekday sequence.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The rollover family reconstructs a wrapped counter and synchronization aligns channels. This family calculates a finite calendar position from a weekday anchor, with no wrap-count ambiguity or cross-channel timing relation.

reasoning_structure: Agents have explicit allowed-item sets and every item must be assigned once; global one-to-one consistency yields a unique perfect matching.
initial_key_fact: The active allowance matrix has exactly one complete matching, even though some individual rows have multiple local choices.
answer_generation_mechanism: Enumerate or propagate one-to-one constraints until the unique complete assignment determines the queried pair.
v_changed_node: An eligibility record directly removes or adds one allowed edge in the bipartite graph.
v_update_mechanism: The modified edge set leaves a different unique perfect matching whose queried pair is the target.
migration_structure: V changes one allowed edge and requires global rematching; non-evidence arms preserve the original matching instance.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The partition family reasons about loss of exclusivity and the reachability family follows directed paths. This family enforces a global bijection across two sets; V changes matching feasibility rather than a partition axiom or reachability edge.

reasoning_structure: Start times and durations define intervals; the queried label is before, overlaps, or contains according to explicit endpoint inequalities.
initial_key_fact: The active start and duration records place two intervals in one unique qualitative relation.
answer_generation_mechanism: Derive both end times, compare the four endpoints, and apply the supplied interval-relation definitions.
v_changed_node: A duration record directly corrects one interval's length while both starts remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected endpoint crosses a relation boundary and makes the target temporal relation uniquely true.
migration_structure: V changes a derived endpoint through duration; N/AO/S preserve the full temporal ordering.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The endpoint family decides whether individual boundary events count and reachability composes graph edges. This family derives interval endpoints and classifies a two-interval relation; no event inclusion convention or graph path is involved.

reasoning_structure: A proposal passes only if supporting vote weight reaches a threshold and no designated veto holder votes against; both conjuncts are necessary.
initial_key_fact: The active roll call fixes weighted support and veto-holder status, yielding one decision under the two-part rule.
answer_generation_mechanism: Sum support weights, evaluate the threshold, separately evaluate the veto condition, and conjoin the results.
v_changed_node: A certified roll-call correction directly changes one member's recorded vote while weights and veto designations remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected vote changes either threshold satisfaction or the veto conjunct and uniquely selects the target decision.
migration_structure: V changes one Boolean vote node in a weighted-and-veto decision circuit; other arms preserve the roll call.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The allocation family uses eligibility in a denominator and the count family enforces exactly-k. This family combines a weighted at-least threshold with an independent veto condition; neither nearest mechanism has that conjunctive decision rule.

reasoning_structure: Tasks form an acyclic prerequisite graph; earliest project completion is the maximum accumulated duration over all prerequisite paths.
initial_key_fact: The active graph and durations identify a unique longest prerequisite path to the terminal task.
answer_generation_mechanism: Propagate earliest finish times in topological order using max over predecessor finishes plus task duration.
v_changed_node: A schedule record directly corrects one task duration while graph edges remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected duration changes which path is critical or changes its total, selecting the target completion time.
migration_structure: V changes one max-plus node weight; N/AO/S preserve all path weights.
nonisomorphism_rationale: Reachability asks whether a path exists and the order family compares noncommuting adjustments. This family computes a maximum weighted path in a DAG; V changes a duration, not connectivity or operation order.

reasoning_structure: A candidate is selected only if it defeats every other candidate in the supplied pairwise comparison table.
initial_key_fact: The complete active table gives one candidate a strict win against each opponent.
answer_generation_mechanism: For each candidate inspect all head-to-head outcomes and identify the unique all-opponent winner, or no such winner.
v_changed_node: An election audit directly corrects one pairwise outcome while all other comparisons remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected edge removes the old all-opponent property and gives the target candidate that property or yields no winner.
migration_structure: V reverses one tournament edge; the final label is recomputed from all pairwise edges.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The tie-break family orders equal scores by a frozen priority and the rule-discovery family selects a hypothesis from trials. This family evaluates a complete directed tournament and requires universal pairwise dominance, with no score tie or hidden rule.

reasoning_structure: Each observation supplies a set containing at least one faulty component; a diagnosis is a minimum-cardinality set intersecting every conflict set.
initial_key_fact: The active conflict sets have a unique minimum hitting set among the listed candidate diagnoses.
answer_generation_mechanism: Test each candidate's intersection with every conflict set, then select the valid candidate of minimum cardinality.
v_changed_node: A diagnostic record directly corrects one conflict set while the other sets remain active.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected family of sets invalidates the old minimum or permits a smaller target hitting set.
migration_structure: V replaces one constraint set and requires global re-evaluation of coverage and minimality.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The disjunctive-alarm family incorrectly selects one cause from a disjunction and the witness family tracks witness identity. This family combines several disjunctive conflict sets and optimizes set cardinality; no single observation or shared witness decides it.

reasoning_structure: Distinct objects occupy a short sequence under explicit before, adjacency, and endpoint constraints; their conjunction yields a unique arrangement or queried position.
initial_key_fact: The active clue set jointly leaves one admissible ordering even though no single clue fixes the answer.
answer_generation_mechanism: Propagate positional constraints or enumerate the finite permutations and select the option true in every surviving arrangement.
v_changed_node: A correction directly replaces one adjacency or endpoint clue while all other clues remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The revised constraint set has a different unique arrangement whose queried position is the target.
migration_structure: V replaces one CSP constraint; N/AO/S retain the original conjunction and unique solution.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The partition family reasons about category exclusivity and the tie-break family resolves equal scores. This family solves a finite permutation CSP combining adjacency and relative-position constraints; no class partition or scoring tie appears.

reasoning_structure: Attributes and functional dependencies define closure; a candidate is a key exactly when its closure contains every schema attribute and no proper subset does.
initial_key_fact: The active dependency set makes one listed candidate uniquely satisfy both completeness and minimality.
answer_generation_mechanism: Iteratively compute each candidate's attribute closure, test full coverage, then test proper-subset minimality.
v_changed_node: A schema correction directly replaces one functional dependency while the attribute universe and other dependencies remain fixed.
v_update_mechanism: The corrected implication changes closure reachability and makes the target candidate the unique minimal key.
migration_structure: V replaces one dependency edge and requires closure plus minimality recomputation; non-evidence arms retain the dependency system.
nonisomorphism_rationale: The rule-directionality family tests a single implication orientation and reachability asks about one graph path. This family computes a fixed point over attribute sets and additionally tests minimality of candidate determinants; neither nearest task has set-valued closure plus minimal-key selection.
